messages:
Priya: Heads up — NimbusCloud product team asked for a compact marketplace quickstart: Terraform + Kubernetes helm/chart + simple AMI/container variants for arm64 and x86. Must include: minimal networking (single VPC/subnet), RBAC + service account example, registry secret setup, outputs for inference endpoint and grafana scrape target, and a tiny acceptance test that actually runs an inference. Theywant a partner preview in 10 business days.

Luca: Ok. I recommend we create two template flavors: 'managed-catalog' that pulls model from Redwood hosted catalog, and 'self-contained' that lets partners bring their own model image. Managed catalog is much lighter for them.

Sam: For terraform structure, let's expose three modules: network, infra (EC2/EKS or instance groups), and workload (helm chart). Keep the example root module as the marketplace template that wires them. Example snippet for root: 
```hcl
module "nimbus_runtime" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/marketplace-templates//nimbus"
  catalog_model = true
  arch = var.arch # "x86" or "arm64"
}
```
We should add `arch` matrix in CI.

Nina: Ops checklist: include an HPA example (if using k8s), nodeSelector for arm64 labels, default autoscale min=1 max=3, and an infra cost-callout in README with rough tokens/sec numbers. Also, add a runbook snippet for rotating registry credentials.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: publish checklist -> quickstart README, architecture diagram, supported regions/arches, security notes, pricing metadata, acceptance tests logs. See internal page: https://internal.redwood/partners/marketplace-guidelines

Priya: Who picks up what? Proposal: Luca owns template wiring + README, Sam owns terraform modules and module docs, Nina owns ops defaults + CI matrix and autoscale policy, I'll own partner comms + marketplace metadata.

Luca: I'll draft the root template and include a small diagram (arch + network). Will add example `outputs.tf` for endpoint and metrics.

Sam: I'll scaffold module layout under `modules/{network,infra,workload}`, add `examples/complete` and `tests/smoke.sh` that runs `/health` and a short generation (50 tokens). Smoke test should be runnable locally and in GH Actions.

Nina: I'll add `ci/matrix.yml` showing arm64/x86 runs and the GH Actions smoke workflow. Example GH Action step: 
```yaml
- name: smoke test
  run: |
    ENDPOINT=$(terraform output -raw endpoint)
    curl -f "$ENDPOINT/health" || exit 1
    curl -s -X POST "$ENDPOINT/generate" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":50}' || exit 1
```
I'll also include a `cost-estimate.md` with throughput numbers for the template defaults.

Priya: Timeline: initial PRs by Tue EOD (6 days), internal review Wed, partner preview next Monday. Quick sync Friday 11am PT — I'll send calendar invite. @Luca @Sam @Nina please drop your PR links in this thread when ready. :rocket:

Sam: :+1: I'll start the module scaffolding today and open a draft PR.

Luca: FYI Nimbus needs the private registry flow documented — I'll add a `registry/README.md` with example `kubectl create secret docker-registry` and an IAM role example.

Nina: Great — ping me when draft PRs land, I'll run the CI matrix and smoke tests.

Priya: Thanks team. I'll DM Nimbus for sandbox account and confirm the list of supported regions. Will post the marketplace checklist once they share their sandbox details.
